recommended_decision: Ordinary-nonmetal current field14 target T, normalize known toolkit ingress to E+R; derive residual for consumers; retain named metal/H exceptions and one owner. Requires public/model/encoding approval.

source_inspection_limits: Initial unrestricted production rg exceeded the child-process output buffer and was replaced by file-type/path-bounded searches.

Some grouped source outputs were truncated; relevant rule/adapter/default-contract ranges were reread in smaller groups. A recorded range is an inspection locator, not a claim that every grouped output was complete.
Outer artifact/assembly/PyG and native-fact matches are symbol inventories only; no dynamic consumer or training-corpus audit was executed.
No Stage7E private slot, opaque-source or ABI entry decision is frozen by this proposal.

commands:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1]); s=Path(sys.argv[2]); e=json.loads((p/'evidence.json').read_text())
assert sorted(q.name for q in p.iterdir())==['consumer_matrix.md','evidence.json','review.md']
assert e['status']=='PROPOSED / NOT APPROVED / NO STAGE7E ENTRY'
assert not e['approved'] and not e['stage7e_entry']
for name,identity in e['outputs'].items():
 data=(p/name).read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==identity['sha256']
 text=data.decode()
 assert e['status'] in text
 assert not any(line.rstrip()!=line for line in text.splitlines())
 for link in re.findall(r'(?<!!)\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
  location=link.split('#',1)[0]
  if not location or '://' in location: continue
  location=re.sub(r':\d+$','',location)
  assert (p/location).exists(),(name,link)
for identity in e['provenance']['original_artifacts'].values():
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(identity['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity['sha256']
assert len(e['source_hashes'])==45
assert e['runtime_evidence']['fixtures']==8 and e['runtime_evidence']['states']==24
for name in ['review.md','consumer_matrix.md']:
 original_name='proposal.md' if name=='review.md' else name
 original=(s/original_name).read_text().splitlines()
 preserved=(p/name).read_text().splitlines()
 assert len(original)==len(preserved)
 assert all(a==b for a,b in zip(original,preserved) if not a.startswith('Status:'))
print('PASS: JSON, explicit status, original/output hashes, local Markdown links, whitespace, exact output scope, unchanged non-status content, 45 source identities and 8/24 observation metadata; no production inspection or runtime execution.')
artifact_validation.limits: Document/artifact checks only. Existing source/runtime evidence is attributed to its original review/executor; no new chemistry, native/model, build, performance or acceptance evidence.
